lxc_bc254bcd76550e6f.text: A wand toy lets the cat follow a moving toy while your hands stay away from its claws.

lxc_5248fb037bdad427.text: Scratching removes the old outer cover from their claws.

lxc_8dcb521a987fc0e2.text: Give the cat a sturdy scratching post that does not wobble.

lxc_7e77c92ec0c144cb.text: Clean litter: Put the litter box in a quiet place that the cat can reach.

lxc_199c0e7f7b7b4cf9.text: Scoop solid waste from it at least once a day.

lxc_115e2676ee7a86bb.text: A quiet sleep place: Give the cat a clean, dry place to rest.

lxc_11023a65d88a9a1c.text: A soft, warm blanket or towel makes a simple bed.

lxc_57374b2ee82daa85.text: Veterinary care: A cat should see a veterinarian at least once a year, and at once if it is sick or hurt.

lxc_e983429c01bec999.text: A veterinarian can give advice for the cat's age and health.
